image_instructions.prompt:
A primary logo wordmark for a specialty coffee roastery, rendered as a real object: the name freshly burned into a thick slab of oak with a branding iron, still smoking. Wide landscape frame.

TEXT, exactly as written, two lines only:
Line 1 (headline, dominant): "EMBER & OAK"
Line 2 (subhead): "COFFEE ROASTERS"
No other words, numbers or marks anywhere.

COMPOSITION: A single heavy horizontal plank of quarter-sawn white oak spans almost the full width of the frame, centred. It has a narrow dark margin left and right, and slightly more dark space above than below. Its ends are squared and lightly eased, and its thick front edge is visible. "EMBER & OAK" runs across the plank on one line, centred and sitting optically just above the plank's middle. It spans roughly three quarters of the frame's width and stops well short of the plank ends, so wood frames it on both sides. Below it, after a clear band of bare grain, "COFFEE ROASTERS" is centred on the same axis. It runs much smaller and about half the headline's width, set in widely spaced small caps. Above the plank's top right corner, in the dark, one thin ribbon of grey smoke curls upward and drifts off-frame. It is the only element breaking the symmetry. Everything else is calm, centred and balanced.

LETTERFORMS: Heavy bracketed slab-serif capitals, moderately wide, with near-uniform stroke weight. The serifs are square and blunt, like the face of a forged iron. Tracking is generous, so each letter is a separate, clean impression. The ampersand is broad and upright, never italic, with a rounded bowl and a sturdy slab foot. The subhead uses the same slab family, lighter in weight and burned shallower.

MATERIAL OF THE LETTERS: Every stroke is sunk a few millimetres below the wood surface. The stroke floors are deep char black (#2A1A10), matte and velvety, with fine alligator crackle and carbon checking. Edges are slightly irregular and heat-softened, never laser-crisp. Along the rims of the headline strokes a thin line of live ember glows orange (#F28C28), brightest in the counters of the O, the A and the ampersand bowl, with tiny sparks of glow in the cracks. The subhead carries only a faint dying ember. Around every letter a soft scorched-brown halo (#6B4423) bleeds outward into the grain, darkest near the stroke and fading to raw wood.

WOOD: Honey oak (#B07A43) with straight grain, silvery ray-fleck figure, fine pores and subtle saw texture. Light catches the raised grain beside the burned recesses, so the sunken depth reads clearly.

LIGHT AND ATMOSPHERE: Warm, low side light rakes across the plank from the left. It skims the grain, throws small shadows into the left inner walls of each burned stroke and lights the smoke from the side. The ember rims add their own small orange glow upward onto the surrounding wood. Faint wisps of smoke lift from the hottest letters. The background is a deep roastery dark (#120C08) that falls off softly into near-black at the corners, with only a hint of warm haze behind the plank. The mood is warm, crafted and permanent, like the sign hanging over a roaster. It is not rustic kitsch, not a western saloon and not a wedding sign.

The wordmark must read instantly as a clean, bold logo: high contrast between black char and honey wood, with the silhouettes of the letters crisp enough to survive being shrunk to a cup or label.

image_instructions.prompt:
A logo wordmark burned into wood, landscape format. A thick slab of pale quarter-sawn oak (#C89A64) fills the frame almost edge to edge, with only a thin dark vignette (#3A2A20) at the outer borders. Silvery medullary rays and fine growth rings run horizontally across the whole board. The surface is clean, satin and unfinished.

HEADLINE, exact text: "EMBER & OAK". It sits on one centred line, slightly above the vertical centre, spanning about three-quarters of the board's width with even margins left and right. The letterforms are custom Clarendon-style bold slab serif capitals:
- large rounded bracketed serifs
- thick vertical stems against medium-weight horizontals
- sturdy, upright Victorian-masthead proportions
- small ink-trap notches where strokes meet

Every letter has been pressed about 2mm into the oak by a red-hot branding iron. Each stroke is a crisp sunken channel with clean vertical walls, its floor filled with matte charcoal black (#1E1410) and cracked into fine alligator-skin char. Around every letter, a soft scorch halo (#6B3F22) fades outward into the open grain, darkest at the edge and following the wood fibres.

THE AMPERSAND is the centrepiece and peak moment. It is an oversized, curvaceous Clarendon ampersand, centred in the line, rising noticeably taller than the capitals and dropping slightly below the baseline. It reads as a vertical medallion between EMBER and OAK. This burn is still alive: deep in its cracked char, veins of live ember glow orange (#FF6A1F). They are brightest in the ampersand's lower bowl and tail and fade to dull red where the char cools. Tiny sparks drift up from it, and it casts a faint warm glow onto the nearby wood.

SUBHEAD, exact text: "COFFEE ROASTERS". It is set in small, widely letter-spaced Clarendon-style slab capitals, centred directly below the headline with a clear band of bare grain between the two lines. It runs about half the headline's width and is branded with a shallower, lighter iron, with thinner char and tighter scorch halos.

LIGHT: warm, low raking light from the upper left grazes the board. It picks out the grain texture and throws deep shadow inside each burned channel along its upper-left walls. The broad flat floors of the stems absorb the light as dense matte black. The rounded serif brackets catch soft warm fill bouncing up from below, so their curved walls show a subtle amber rim and the letters look dimensional.

Atmosphere: faint wisps of grey smoke curl up from the freshest strokes, strongest around the ampersand, and thin out into clear air. The rest of the frame stays calm. Roughly a quarter of the board is left as open, uninterrupted oak grain framing the mark.

The lockup is perfectly centred and symmetric on one vertical axis, with optically even spacing. It is bold and simple enough to read as a strong silhouette at small sizes. Close macro product-photograph realism, tactile and artisanal, with a confident, warm, permanent mood. No other text, no logos, no extra lettering anywhere.

Its floor is matte charcoal black #1A120D with crackled carbon texture, its outer edges are soft and scorched, and a soft brown scorch halo surrounds each letter. Along the rim where char meets raw grain, a thin seam of live ember #FF8A1F still glows, brightest in the E's and the O. The letter silhouettes stay crisp, solid and highly legible: dark letters on pale wood.

SUBHEAD, burned shallower directly beneath it, exactly: "COFFEE ROASTERS". The hierarchy comes from the scale contrast between the massive burned name and the small refined subhead. The design is calm, centred and handcrafted, limited to char black, oak, toasted brown and ember orange, so it would still read as a strong silhouette when printed small on a coffee bag or cup. image_instructions.prompt:
A square logo: a circular heritage cooperage seal that looks like a brand burned into the head of an old oak barrel. Craft and provenance lead. The seal fills nearly the whole canvas with a slim margin, centred on a dark Roasted Umber (#2B1A10) background with soft warm amber falloff and faint dust. The seal is a disc of Oak Honey (#C98A4B) wood with visible plank seams, fine grain, small knots, darker char at the rim and a few iron-hoop-like rings. Burned into it is a double-rule circular border, a thick ring inside a thin ring, with small diamond ornaments breaking the ring at the quarters. Everything is worn, with slightly broken edges, as a hot branding iron would leave it.

TYPE: all lettering is old-style humanist serif capitals with diagonal stress from a broad-nib pen, bracketed serifs with soft curved transitions, moderate thick-thin contrast and a visible calligraphic entry angle. It is Parchment Cream (#E8D5B0), burned and inked into the oak with a slightly pressed, uneven edge. Thick strokes sit a little deeper than the thin ones, and the diagonal axis shows as a gentle tonal shift. Keep it legible at small size and workable in one or two colours.

LAYOUT, centred and symmetrical:
1. Upper band: "SMALL-BATCH COFFEE ROASTERS" in small, widely tracked capitals, curved along the top arc of the inner ring. It spans a bit over half the seal width, with the letters fanning outward evenly.
2. Centre, dominant: "EMBER & OAK" in large capitals on one straight horizontal line across the middle of the seal, about two thirds of the width. The ampersand is a slightly smaller, calligraphic old-style ampersand that sits on the same baseline. This is the first thing the eye lands on, with generous air above and below.
3. Below the name, centred, small: a compact ember-and-leaf mark. It is a single oak leaf with rounded lobes, its centre vein replaced by a glowing flame teardrop. The flame is Ember Orange (#D9531E) with a pale hot core and is the only saturated colour in the piece. The leaf is outlined in Parchment Cream. It is about a fifth of the seal width.
4. Lower line, two small blocks sharing one baseline: "EST. {{founding_year}}" left of centre and "{{city_name}}" right of centre, separated by a small gap and a tiny diamond. Both are small tracked capitals, with the year block slightly wider than the city block.

LIGHT AND MOOD: warm soft amber light from the upper left, giving the wood a gentle sheen, a darker rim and a faint char halo around the burned marks. The look is aged, nostalgic and trustworthy, with subtle patina and no neon. The palette is limited to umber, oak honey, parchment cream and the single ember orange accent. The logo is flat-on and centred with no perspective and no extra text.

Letterform: very heavy, nearly uniform stroke weight with very low contrast, thick rectangular bracketed serifs that lock into a hard baseline and a hard cap-height line, moderately wide proportions, clean rectangular counters, thick centred crossbars. Deep fissures split open across the letter bodies, following the grain. Inside each crack is a molten core glowing Ember Orange #FF5A1F with a thin white-yellow hot line at its centre. The cracks cast warm orange light onto the surrounding charred wood, and the underside of every letter picks up an amber rim light from below. The letters stay mostly dark and solid so the cracks read as fire inside wood, not as flames around it.

AMPERSAND: the "&" is the same slab-weight glyph but the brightest element of the piece. It is cracked wide open and filled with glowing molten metal-bright coals, Hot Amber #FFB347 at the core fading to Ember Orange at the edges. It emits a visible bloom and a soft halo, a tall vertical column of heat at the centre of the mark, so fire and wood meet in one glyph. Faint heat shimmer rises above it.

ATMOSPHERE: a few small orange embers drift upward around the ampersand and across the word, some tiny and some larger, sparse and not a storm. One or two thin wisps of translucent charcoal smoke curl up from the tops of the letters. There are no flames engulfing the letters and no other objects.

TAGLINE: below the headline, with clear air between, the words "SMALL-BATCH COFFEE ROASTERS" on one line in small widely tracked capitals, in Ash Cream #E9DCC5. It is set in a clean refined slab-influenced caps face with moderate weight, spanning about half the canvas width and centred under the title. It is crisp, flat and legible, with no glow, and it is much smaller than the headline.

Balance: the headline dominates, the ampersand is the eye's first landing point, and the tagline sits quietly beneath with generous empty margins above and below the group. The mark stays bold and simple enough to read as a small avatar or on a cup sleeve.

image_instructions.prompt:
Create a finished 3:2 primary logo for a coffee roastery, a tactile heritage sign called Charred Craft. The entire composition is centered and deliberately spacious on a single deep roast-black oak plank, its horizontal grain visible in warm oak-tan ridges, old smoke-darkened pores, and restrained hand-worked patina. No extra wording.

At the upper center, place a small, symmetrical ember emblem: two short curved oak-leaf or flame-like carved marks facing inward, dark branded wood with a thin banked-orange glow caught along their singed inner edges.

The dominant headline sits across the middle, spanning broadly but leaving generous side margins: set exactly “EMBER & OAK” as one line in custom classic American Western slab display lettering. Build each letter heavy and wide with uniform strokes, bold rectangular unbracketed serifs, flat-cut terminals, and a subtle recessed inline channel through the central strokes. Make the letters look deeply branded and carved into the oak: ember-brown charred faces, nearly black burned recesses, dry cracked edges, and narrow banked-orange heat along selective lower and inner edges. Hard warm side light from the upper left creates crisp horizontal highlights on the slab serifs and deep shadow in the inline grooves. Preserve razor-clear, highly legible letter shapes; the ampersand is a strong matching slab ampersand.

Below, centered and much smaller, set exactly “COFFEE ROASTERS” in widely tracked parchment-cream small caps, cleanly stamped into a narrow calm band of wood beneath the headline. Beneath that, run a long thin centered engraved rule across most of the lower width, interrupted only by tiny ember-orange scorch flecks at its ends. Keep the emblem, headline, descriptor, and rule vertically ordered with generous air. Warm amber falloff, faint sawdust and ash motes only near the plank surface, no cups, beans, people, badges, locations, dates, or additional text. The result must read immediately as a durable premium roastery brand mark for bags, cups, signage, and digital avatars: handcrafted, rugged, warm, and confident.

image_instructions.prompt:
竖版3:4儿童生日海报，明亮的儿童绘本卡通插画风格，热闹、好笑、充满被宠爱的小英雄感。所有元素统一使用平涂色块、柔和体积阴影和粗泥土棕（#5A3E2B）描边，暖阳从左上方照来。

【顶部天空与标题区】
画面上部是大片晴空蓝（#7FD1F2）天空，点缀几朵圆胖白云。
- 最上方居中是一行小号英文眉题“HAPPY BIRTHDAY”。它不到画幅宽度的三分之二，用超粗圆角无衬线字母，阳光黄（#FFD43B）糖果漆面，深棕描边，薄薄的立体挤出，字距稍宽。
- 紧接其下是全画面最大的主标题“小雨 8 岁啦！”，几乎横跨整个画幅宽度，左右只留窄边。
  - 骨架：超粗圆角中文黑体，字重极重，笔画末端圆润饱满，字距紧凑，像一块块鼓胀的糖果砖挤在一起。
  - 材质：字身是火山橙（#FF8A1F）光亮糖果漆塑料，带深棕色粗描边和厚实的深橙褐色立体挤出。每个字左上角有一块圆形白色高光，映着左上方的暖阳。
  - 背刺：每个字（包括数字“8”和感叹号）顶部长出一排小三角形恐龙背刺，背刺是蕨叶绿（#2F9E5B）糖果塑料，与橙色字身撞色，同样有深棕描边。
  - 数字“8”略放大成视觉重音。
  - 主标题周围飘着阳光黄彩带和少量彩色纸屑。

【中部主场景（画面最大区域）】
- 一只圆滚滚的胖绿色霸王龙，身体是明亮的草绿与蕨叶绿，肚皮浅黄绿。它咧嘴大笑，眼睛弯成月牙。
- 头戴橙黄条纹的派对尖帽，帽尖顶着小毛球。嘴里叼着一根点燃的条纹生日蜡烛，火苗明黄。
- 它从层层叠叠的大蕨叶和棕榈丛中猛地向前探身撞出，蕨叶被撞得向两侧飞散，小短手兴奋地张开。
- 它的头部和派对帽正好轻轻顶到主标题下沿，像要把字顶起来，把标题和场景连成一体。
- 丛林以蕨叶绿为主色，远处有一座冒着粉色烟圈的小火山。
- 地面是泥土棕的小路，散落彩色纸屑；两侧飘着几个恐龙蛋形状的气球，椭圆形，带斑点，分别为阳光黄、晴空蓝和火山橙，用细绳系着。

【底部】
- 恐龙脚下的前景地面上，居中放副标题“欢迎来到小雨的侏罗纪乐园”。它宽度约为画幅的四分之三，左右对称留白，与主标题同一种超粗圆角黑体骨架，但没有背刺，字号小得多。字身奶白，深棕描边，轻微立体挤出，压在一条阳光黄的卡通丝带横幅上。
- 最下方居中是一枚窄小的圆角徽章，宽度约为画幅的三分之一多。徽章是火山橙底，配深棕描边和蕨叶绿小背刺边饰，像探险队勋章，里面一行文字“恐龙探险队 · 队长”，用奶白粗圆体，带小立体挤出。
- 徽章四周留出宽松的空气。

【排版】
全部文字居中对称，层级为主标题、恐龙、副标题、徽章、眉题。整体上重、中满、下轻，四周边距宽松，色彩明快饱和。

画面上只出现以上四行文字，不添加任何其他字。

【背景与氛围】满版热带丛林。大面积丛林绿（#2E8B57）的宽大蕉叶和蕨类层层叠叠，叶缘用深绿粗线描边，从画面左右两侧边缘向中心包裹，中间留出舞台。顶部有暖阳光黄（#FFD23F）的圆形光斑从叶缝间洒落。远处中景有一座圆胖的小火山，冒着淡淡的粉色烟雾。天空是柔和的浅暖色。

【顶部小标签】画面最上方居中，宽度约占画面八成，是一条较窄的小标签行，写“侏罗纪生日大冒险”。字形是弹跳的圆胖手绘字，每个字高低错落，幅度比大标题小。字身奶油白（#FFF6E0），粗深绿圆润描边，托在一条火山橙的圆角小飘带上。

【大标题，视觉第一落点】紧贴小标签下方，几乎横跨整个画面宽度，左右只留窄窄的边。写“小雨 8 岁啦！”，是全画面最大、最重的文字。字形是弹跳展示体：每个字上下弹跳，相邻字的高度相差明显，像在蹦跳。笔画极粗、胖嘟嘟，所有转角和收笔都圆润，字宽有大有小。数字“8”特别放大，像两个叠起来的圆气球，比其他字更高。字身是火山橙（#FF8C2B），扁平填色，带一层稍深的橙色两层色阴影。外面是一圈厚厚的奶油白描边，最外层再加一道深绿粗轮廓。每个字因为落脚高度不同，投下角度各异的短投影，整行形成跳动的光影节奏。顶部光斑在字的上沿留下阳光黄的小高光。

【中部主体插画】标题下方是画面主体，宽度约占画面八成，居中，占据画面近一半高度，是整张海报的故事中心。一只圆滚滚的嫩芽绿（#7ED957）胖霸王龙从丛林叶片之间探出上半身，肚皮是浅黄绿色。它头戴一顶橙黄条纹的派对尖纸帽，帽尖有小绒球，咧着大嘴开心地咆哮，露出圆圆的小牙，眼睛弯弯的。小短手努力捧着一个奶油白的双层奶油蛋糕，蛋糕上插着8根彩色蜡烛，火苗是阳光黄，周围有柔和的暖光晕。嘴边有几道卡通咆哮弧线和小音符状线条。左右前景的蕉叶部分遮住恐龙的身体边缘，营造它正从丛林里探头的感觉。

【底部祝福语】主体下方居中，宽度略窄于主体。一片横放的浅奶油色大叶片作为托底，叶脉淡淡可见，叶缘深绿描边。叶片上写“嗷呜——祝小雨生日快乐！”，用同款弹跳圆胖字，跳动幅度较小。字身火山橙，奶油白描边，加深绿外轮廓，字号明显小于大标题。叶片下方留出干净的丛林底边，作为呼吸空间。

画面中除上述三行文字外，不出现任何其他文字、字母或符号。文字逐字准确，不改动、不增减。整体可爱、明快、热闹，8岁孩子一眼就会爱上这只恐龙。

Background is a bright grass green (#7ED957) with a soft lighter sunburst glow behind the dinosaur, rolling grass hills at the bottom, and a candy-glossy toy look throughout.

1. Headline, spanning nearly the full width at the top: "小雨 8 岁啦！" as massive chunky 3D extruded Chinese characters, extrusion depth about half the character height. Front faces are ultra-glossy lacquer like hard candy or toy paint, with a bright specular highlight fading to deep saturated colour at the edges. Side walls are a noticeably darker shade of the same hue, with hard sharp corners. Each character has its own vivid colour: sunshine yellow #FFD93B, orange-red #FF7A59, sky blue #3BA7FF, and cream white; the numeral 8 is the biggest and brightest sunshine yellow. A long cast shadow falls at 45 degrees onto the grass. A thin cream outline separates the letters from the green.
2. Subhead directly under it, in a narrower centered block: "恐龙生日派对" in the same glossy 3D candy lettering at about a third of the headline size, orange-red face with a cream rim and darker side walls.
3. Subject block in the centre, wide and tall: the round, plump T-rex in orange-red with a lighter cream belly, tiny arms, a big friendly smile with a few rounded teeth, rosy cheeks and big sparkling eyes. A striped sky-blue and yellow party hat sits on its head with a pom-pom. It holds a round layered cake with cream frosting, cherries and lit candles, and a big glossy yellow number 8 stands on top. The skin has a glossy vinyl-toy sheen with soft rim light, a cream outline and a soft ground shadow.
4. Around the dinosaur, floating asymmetrically and weightless: shiny foil balloons in sky blue and orange-red (some star-shaped, some round) with curling ribbons, tossed confetti and streamers in yellow, blue, orange-red and white, cute stars, hearts and small sparkles. Elements vary in size (large, medium, tiny), some close to the dinosaur and some far, with clear air between them and the text, never covering the lettering.
5. Below the subject, a centered line in cream-white rounded bold type with a soft dark-green shadow for legibility: "来和小雨一起吼出：生日快乐！"
6. Two lines of details, centered and a little smaller, in cream-white bold rounded type: "{{party_date}} · {{party_time}}" then "{{party_place}}", with generous spacing between them and a clear margin at the bottom.

Energy: maximum saturation and joy, never muted or dark; hierarchy is headline first, then the dinosaur and cake, then the invitation line, then details. Render all Chinese text exactly as quoted, with no other text.

2. 紧接其下，几乎占满画面全宽的巨大标题：「小雨」，是全图最醒目的主角。阳光黄（#FFC93C）的充气气球般的圆润粗体字，笔画极厚，转角浑圆，表面光滑闪亮，带白色圆形高光和底部橙色反光；外围一圈很粗的黑色描边，再加一层奶油白外描边。两个字弹跳错位，「雨」比「小」高出约四分之一字高，字宽不同，各自投下角度不同的柔和深绿阴影。字的下半部压在丛林前景中。

4. 下方居中，较窄的一条：「恐龙探险队 · 8岁啦！」，奶油白圆润粗体，深色描边，稍有弹跳，居中，宽度约三分之二。
5. 再下一行，略窄且更小：「{{party_date}} · {{party_place}}」，奶油白清晰的圆体字，放在半透明深绿丛林色底条上保证可读。

【布局】文字块全部居中对齐，层级清楚：先看到巨大的黄色「小雨」，再看到探出头的恐龙，然后读上方小标和下方三行小字。上下边缘留有安全边距，下方三行小字之间留有呼吸空间，不要被装饰遮住。所有汉字笔画必须清晰完整、无错字。

设计一张完整、精致的中文儿童生日祝福海报，竖幅，主题是小雨的恐龙岛，不是活动邀请函。整体是手工彩色厚纸搭建的立体纸雕插画，纸面可见细小纤维，裁切边缘略有自然起伏，各层纸片之间有柔软、短促的投影。使用丛林绿#214F3D、嫩叶绿#A8CC79、阳光奶油#FFF1CD、熟橘色#F39A45。奶油色天空铺满画面，文字背后保持干净连续，不加边框。

严格按以下顺序排入四行文字，逐字准确，不增加其他文字、标识或装饰性字母：
第一行“小雨的恐龙岛”：位于顶部宽阔标题区，左右留宽松且相等的安全边距，横向铺展至接近整幅宽度。左对齐，粗重略宽的定制圆角黑体，横竖笔画粗细接近一致，结构清楚，宽敞字腔、略松字距。深绿色哑光厚纸字面，微微浮起，边缘有细微纸张裁切波动，不能出现尖锐转角。
第二行“8岁生日快乐”：紧接标题下方，共用相同左边缘和宽幅文字区域，独立成行，保留清楚的行间呼吸。同一圆角黑体骨架，数字8明显放大，两个内孔圆润饱满，以熟橘色突出；其余文字深绿色。整行宽度不越过标题区，不能与场景相撞。

中部是一块横向展开、几乎占满画面宽度的独立恐龙岛纸雕场景，占据视觉中心，和上下文字之间均留出浅色空隙。左侧主角道具是一座厚实的数字8形石拱门，上下两个完整圆孔清楚可辨，暖灰奶油色纸层叠成圆钝石块，底部落在小岛草地上，有少量绿色苔藓纸片。右侧是一只圆润亲切的嫩绿色腕龙，长脖子从蕨叶之间探出，头戴熟橘色纸生日帽，微笑看向石拱门；身体饱满，腿脚钝圆，尾巴自然收进场景，不侵入文字。帽子无文字。远处深浅绿色低矮山丘，中景腕龙与石拱门，前景宽大蕨叶，三层遮挡分明。左右下缘各有一簇贴边生长的蕨叶，左簇稍宽、右簇略高，局部裁出画外；叶片只围合场景，不盖住任何字。所有牙齿和爪子均钝圆，无追逐、捕猎或惊吓元素。

第三行“今天，和恐龙一起长大！”：放在场景下方，左右边距略大于顶部标题，单行居中，深绿色中等字重圆角黑体，清晰醒目。
第四行“勇气＋好奇心，开启新一岁”：置于更下方，左右边距再略收进，单行居中，字号比上一行小，仍保持充分可读的中等字重，深绿色。底部留充足奶油色空白。

阳光统一从左上方照入，厚纸受光面温暖柔和，投影向右下短短落下。场景是主要视觉入口，随后自然读到上方生日标题与下方祝福。保持纸雕的真实厚度与儿童插画的简洁轮廓，不做塑料光泽、金属效果或逼真恐龙皮肤。

Detrás de él se abre un abanico solar Art Déco de rayos escalonados en oro con laca negra entre los rayos, perfectamente simétrico, como una marquesina de teatro. Es la joya del cartel.

Debajo, ocupando casi todo el ancho, va el título «PROMOCIÓN 2026» en dos líneas centradas: «PROMOCIÓN» arriba y «2026» debajo, ligeramente más grande. Las mayúsculas son Art Déco geométricas de trazo grueso, con contraste moderado, remates rectos y proporciones altas y monumentales. La tilde de la Ó va dibujada como una pequeña cuña escalonada. Las letras son oro pulido fundido y estampado, con masa y grosor visibles. Tienen biseles afilados, finos filetes grabados en paralelo en las caras, textura guilloché torneada y una incrustación de laca negra brillante entre las facetas. Los filos muestran acentos de metal claro casi blanco y destellos especulares largos a lo largo de los biseles. Los huecos guardan sombra profunda de ámbar oscuro. Es lo primero que se ve y debe leerse de lejos y en miniatura.

Bajo el título, más estrecho y centrado, va «Fiesta de Graduación» en versalitas romanas finas de alto contraste, color marfil cálido, con tracking amplio y elegante. Debajo de esa línea, un pequeño ornamento centrado: un rombo dorado entre dos filetes cortos escalonados.

Después queda una amplia zona de negro terciopelo vacía y limpia, sin ningún texto ni marco. En la parte inferior, casi a todo el ancho, una orla horizontal Art Déco de oro con escalones y medios abanicos repetidos en simetría, como el friso del Chrysler Building. Algunos fragmentos de pan de oro descansan sobre ella.

La luz es un único foco desde arriba a la izquierda a 45°: brillo especular blanco-champán en las coronas de las letras y en el birrete, y sombras proyectadas nítidas hacia abajo a la derecha. El fondo es negro absoluto, sin luz de relleno, de modo que toda la luminosidad pertenece al oro. Un fino polvo de diamante flota alrededor del birrete y del título en micro-destellos prismáticos, sin tapar las letras.

Paleta: negro terciopelo #0B0B0D, oro viejo profundo #C9A24A (nunca amarillo), destellos #F3D98B, marfil #F4EEDF para el subtítulo, ámbar sombra #5A4520 en la profundidad del metal.

El único texto en la imagen es «PROMOCIÓN 2026» y «Fiesta de Graduación». No hay ningún otro texto, número, firma ni llaves.

image_instructions.prompt:
Cartel vertical de graduación de secundaria, concebido para leerse de lejos. Fondo liso violeta profundo #29145C, con una suave transición tonal sin textura. Composición frontal, centrada y con márgenes generosos.

En la mitad superior, un titular monumental ocupa casi todo el ancho útil. Apila «PROMOCIÓN» sobre «2026», formando un solo bloque compacto y perfectamente centrado. Reproduce el texto exactamente como «PROMOCIÓN 2026», con la tilde visible. Diseña cada carácter como un globo de PVC inflado al máximo: trazos gruesos y redondos, centros esféricos que sobresalen, bordes de caída pronunciada y uniones que parecen cilindros hinchados. Acerca las letras entre sí sin perder legibilidad. Predomina el rosa coral #FF5C8A en la palabra, con algunas letras individuales en turquesa claro #58E2D1, lavanda eléctrica y azul cielo; cada cifra es amarillo fiesta #FFCD4A. Cada carácter tiene brillo de laca, un reflejo circular blanco nítido en su parte superior central, sombreado hacia los bordes y sombras profundas en las hendiduras. Luz suave de estudio desde arriba y sombra difusa debajo.

Debajo del titular, deja aire y centra una línea de ancho moderado: «Fiesta de graduación de secundaria». Usa letras blancas limpias, firmes y claramente legibles. Más abajo, con otra pausa amplia, centra en un bloque más estrecho «¡Celebremos juntos!» en blanco, con una presencia ligeramente mayor y redondeada. Mantén despejada la franja inferior: no muestres fecha, hora ni lugar sin resolver.

Enmarca la zona superior y central con confeti tridimensional amarillo, coral y turquesa: pequeñas tiras rizadas, círculos y fragmentos brillantes suspendidos a distintas profundidades. Concéntralos en los bordes, sin tapar ninguna letra. El resultado es festivo, luminoso y pulido, con el titular como protagonista absoluto. No añadas texto, marcas ni símbolos tipográficos adicionales.

A finished 3:4 portrait recruitment poster designed as a clean, restrained financial statement printed on an old ledger page. The entire piece is typography on paper, no illustration. Background: warm cream ledger paper, color #F3EEE2, with fine fibre grain, very faint foxing specks, slightly darkened edges and soft amber light falling evenly. A fine pale-blue (#9FB4C7) ruled accounting grid of thin horizontal lines with a few thin vertical column rules runs across the whole page, quiet and low contrast, with a double vertical margin rule in faded red on the left. All text is letterpress-printed ink with a slight bite into the paper and subtly broken ink edges. Text ink is deep ink navy #14213D. Everything is left-aligned on one strong left margin, with generous margins all round.

Top: a small line "招聘 · 财务 ×2" in modest bold slab-serif-feeling type, spanning roughly the left 60 percent width, with slightly open letterspacing like a ledger column header.

Hero: the headline "一起把账算明白" is by far the largest element, filling nearly the full text width across the upper-middle of the page, in very heavy Clarendon-spirited Chinese characters: thick verticals, strong stroke contrast, sturdy bracketed wedge terminals, tight but even spacing, deep navy. The last two characters "明白" are the ledger total line: set in the same size but in faded ledger red #C8372D, and beneath them runs a double rule, two thin parallel red horizontal lines (a thin line and a slightly thicker line closely spaced) like an accounting sum underline, spanning the left 60 percent of the width, sitting just below the headline.

Below with clear air: the subhead "马来西亚 AI 公司，招两位财务" in medium-weight serif, navy, spanning almost full width as one line. Then a details block: "月薪 RM6000-9000 · 吉隆坡 Bangsar" in medium bold, with the Latin and numbers in Clarendon-style slab serif; then slightly smaller "截止 10 月 15 日" below it, in the left 60 percent, with the date in red.

Bottom, anchored near the lower edge with a large empty ledger-paper gap above it: "Northwind Labs Sdn Bhd" in small Clarendon bold slab serif, navy, then the smallest line "投递 jobs@northwindlabs.my" beneath it, the smallest text on the poster, still crisp and legible.

Hierarchy: headline dominant, then subhead and salary, then deadline, then company, then email smallest. Mood: credible, clean, a little witty, like a balanced set of accounts. No ornaments, no photographs, no extra text.

A finished 3:4 vertical recruitment poster in the language of an open accountant's ledger: a close top-down photograph of a green-ruled ledger page in aged cream (#E9E2CF) paper, with faint foxing, fine paper grain, soft worn corners and warm amber side light with gentle shadow in the gutter. Thin forest-green (#1F5C4A) grid lines run across the whole page, with a faded double vertical margin rule on the left. All type looks hand-written by an accountant with a fountain pen, in muted time-softened ink with slightly broken edges, never neon.

Layout, with about 8% empty margin all round, all text left-aligned on one shared left edge except the email. Top left: a small subhead 「招聘 · 财务 ×2」 in ink-black (#1B1B1F) pen, set in a narrow box about 40% of the width, like a ledger column title with a thin underline. Directly below, the dominant headline 「一起把账算明白」 in ultra-condensed, extra-heavy hand-lettered characters in deep ledger green (#1F5C4A): very tall and narrow, height at least three times width, minimal counters, flat-cut terminals, set in two stacked lines (「一起把账」 over 「算明白」), spanning nearly the full width and about a quarter of the poster height. The ink has soaked into the paper with a faint wet-ink gloss in thin vertical strips on the stems, and slight pen pressure variation. Below it, a smaller subhead 「马来西亚 AI 公司，招两位财务」 in ink-black, about half the poster width.

Middle band, left side, about 42% of the width: three ruled ledger rows, each sitting on its own green rule line, in ink-black handwriting: 「月薪 RM6000-9000」 (largest of the three), 「地点：吉隆坡 Bangsar」, 「截止：10 月 15 日」. Around the salary a loose, hand-drawn red-pen (#C8352B) circle, drawn in one sweeping stroke that overshoots slightly, with the salary in red ink. Nothing else is red.

Right side, in the lower middle (the right half, from about the middle to the right margin): a still life on the page, a brass-edged pocket calculator, a fountain pen with its cap off lying diagonally, and a small stack of cream receipts held by a green rubber band, with soft warm shadows, plus a few neat rows of hand-written numbers with their decimal points perfectly aligned in a column, as if the numbers had just balanced.

Bottom, left: 「Northwind Labs Sdn Bhd」 in ink-black pen, medium-small, on the bottom rule. Bottom right: 「jobs@northwindlabs.my」 in the smallest type on the poster, ink-black, right-aligned to the margin. Reproduce every Chinese and English string exactly as quoted, with no other words, no year, no extra text. Trustworthy, practical, friendly, with a dry wink of humour, readable at a glance on a phone.

image_instructions.prompt:
设计一张完成度高、适合线上转发与张贴的中文财务招聘海报，竖幅。视觉概念是排得清清楚楚的一张账页：信息像关键账目一样可查，标题首先抓住视线。整版为暖白棉纸，底色 #F3F0E6，细而均匀的纸纤维仅在近看时可见。主要文字为墨绿 #163E32，表格线为浅灰绿 #D5DBCE，朱橙 #D85732 只用于薪资旁的一条短标记。采用正面平视、无透视变形的平面印刷版面，柔和均匀照明。

严格仅呈现以下七条文字，逐字保持原文、大小写、空格及标点，不添加其他文字：
标题：“一起把账算明白”
副标题：“马来西亚 AI 公司，招两位财务”
薪资：“月薪 RM6000-9000”
地点：“工作地点｜吉隆坡 Bangsar”
公司名：“Northwind Labs Sdn Bhd”
截止日期：“投递截止｜10月15日”
邮箱：“投递邮箱｜jobs@northwindlabs.my”

所有文字共用同一左对齐轴，左右边距宽裕且对称，文字区域横跨版面大部分宽度。公司名放在最上方靠左，字号克制，右侧留空；其下保留明确呼吸间隔。标题占据上部最主要的大块区域，分两行，在“账”字后换行，保持同一左边缘，第二行右侧自然留白。标题必须全版最大，宽阔方整的超粗中文黑体骨架，横竖笔画接近等粗，转折方正，撇捺收口干净，字内留白充分，字距略紧但字字独立。两行紧凑而不碰触，字形不拉伸。字面为深墨绿平整哑光油墨，锐利轮廓仅带极轻纸张吸墨纹理，局部可见细微压印凹痕，无描边、无立体投影。

副标题单独成行，位于标题下方、版面中部偏上，字号明显小于标题，清楚稳健。副标题与下部账格之间留出宽松间隔。下半部设置一个略宽于文字区域的疏朗账格，以细横线形成薪资和地点两行，以少量细竖线收束结构；线条轻而精确，不穿过文字。薪资位于第一行，字号仅次于标题，整行文字统一左轴，数字等高、清楚稳定；薪资下方配一条朱橙短线，不延伸至其他信息。地点位于第二行，字号小于薪资，两行之间有充足间隔。账格内文字清晰，周围保留空白。

账格下方依次排截止日期与邮箱，截止日期靠近下部，邮箱独立位于最底部并留安全底边。邮箱全版字号最小，但须完整、清晰可读，不裁切。其他辅助文字采用与标题协调的端正黑体，拉丁字母清晰，字重有层级。全版保留约四分之一的干净留白。不要桌面、文具、旧纸污渍、装饰照片、图标、额外标签或装饰文字；以纸纤维、墨层和精确细账格完成画面。

image_instructions.prompt:
制作一张完整中文招聘海报，竖版，概念为一页放大的现代对账单。以清晰的账表结构呈现招聘条件，不添加任何未指定文字、数字、标志或图标。

整页铺满米白色 #F3F0E5 无涂层账纸，仅见极细微自然纸纤维，干净不泛黄。正视纸面，边缘不卷曲，无桌面、文具、手掌、装订、透视或立体投影。正文与公司名采用深墨绿 #123F34 浓实专色油墨，清晰锐利。

构图左右留等宽且宽松的页边，所有主要文字块共享左侧对齐边，横跨几乎整个版心。顶部保留呼吸空间，主标题占据上部约四分之一画面，是全页最大、最重的视觉墨块。准确排入“一起把账算明白”，仅此标题分成两行，上行“一起把账”，下行“算明白”；两行紧密、左对齐，下行保持同等字大，不拉伸填满。标题区不画网格。

标题字形采用极粗几何无衬线，近等粗笔画，宽阔方正字面，紧密而不粘连，端头严格直角平切；汉字内部开口清楚，避免笔画堵塞。标题材质为深墨绿色冲压钢，字面与纸面视觉齐平，不挤出、不投影。平行的平切端面接住同一方向的柔和主光，形成克制、整齐的宽条浅绿高光，主体仍保持浓深墨绿，呈现坚实机械重量；不要亮银色、镜面炫光或浮雕效果。其余纸面照明均匀柔和。

标题下留明显空隙，单行左对齐排入“马来西亚 AI 公司，招两位财务”，字号明显小于标题但清楚醒目。再隔一段留白，单行排入“Northwind Labs Sdn Bhd”，使用高字身、平切端头的清晰几何无衬线，字号稍小。

下半部设置与上方版心等宽的横向账表，浅灰绿 #B9C8B4 极细外框与横向分隔线，单列三行，不添加栏名或编号。表内文字比表框略向右缩进，并共享同一左对齐边。最高的首行整格填充荧光黄绿 #D7F15B，准确排入“月薪 RM6000-9000”，以粗体深墨绿突出，成为第二视觉焦点。下一行留宽松上下空白，准确排入“地点｜吉隆坡 Bangsar”。末行准确排入“截止｜10 月 15 日”。黄绿不得出现在薪资格以外。

账表结束后保留独立空白带，接近页面底部沿主版心左边缘单行排入“投递邮箱｜jobs@northwindlabs.my”，使用全页最小但清楚可读的字号。所有指定文案逐字准确，保持空格、大小写及标点，不增补年份、职责、福利或其他内容。

image_instructions.prompt:
Arte plana da capa (wrap) de um copo de café para viagem da cafeteria Grão de Ouro, de Belo Horizonte, vista de frente como um painel retangular horizontal. Base: papel cartão marrom espresso (#2B1A12) de acabamento fosco aveludado, com fibra fina e discreta revelada por uma luz lateral suave e rasante vinda da esquerda. Sem brilho no papel e sem objetos ao redor: pura tipografia de luxo.

Composição perfeitamente centrada num único eixo vertical, com margens laterais amplas e muito ar.

No topo, centralizado, um pequeno emblema: um único grão de café estilizado em folha de ouro, com o sulco central desenhado por um fio fino.

Logo abaixo, a linha "DESDE 1998" em versaletes pequenas de serifa clássica, com espaçamento largo e calmo, em ouro velho foil. É delicada e ocupa uma faixa curta no centro.

O título dominante "Grão de Ouro" atravessa quase toda a largura do painel numa só linha, grande e imponente. É o primeiro ponto onde o olho pousa e se lê de longe. Letreiro desenhado como serifa romana de alto contraste:
- peso médio-forte e proporções levemente largas;
- hastes grossas, finos como fio de cabelo e serifas finas em cunha;
- terminais em gota no "r" e no "a" e til do "ã" desenhado como uma pincelada fina;
- o "O" de "Ouro" é um círculo geométrico perfeito com um pequeno grão de café em relevo no centro.

Executado em hot stamping de folha de ouro: o ouro afunda levemente no cartão por relevo seco, com bordas nítidas e limpas. O brilho metálico quente varia de ouro velho (#C9A24A) a dourado claro (#E8C979), numa faixa suave de reflexo que percorre as letras como se acompanhasse a curvatura do copo. Microtextura de folha visível nos realces.

Abaixo, com respiro claro, o slogan "Café de verdade, sem pressa" em serifa itálica clássica, média e elegante, impresso em creme de leite fosco (#F3E9D6). É centralizado e mais estreito que o título, numa só linha.

Em seguida, um filete horizontal curto e fino em folha de ouro, centralizado, com um pequeno losango no meio.

No rodapé, "Belo Horizonte · MG" em versaletes pequenas, espaçadas e refinadas, em creme fosco, na mesma largura curta do "DESDE 1998" para fechar a simetria.

Hierarquia por contraste de escala: topo minúsculo, título massivo e rodapé discreto. Ritmo vertical calmo, sem pressa. Sensação de objeto de presente e tradição mineira de café e ouro. Paleta restrita a espresso, ouro velho, dourado claro e creme. Nenhum outro texto além dessas quatro linhas.

image_instructions.prompt:
Arte plana e contínua de embalagem: faixa envolvente (wrap) para copo de café de papel para viagem, impressa, em formato panorâmico largo, com a frente do copo no centro. A arte é vista de frente, plana, sem mockup e sem perspectiva. A tipografia é a marca: a faixa parece a vitrine pintada à mão de uma cafeteria antiga de Belo Horizonte aberta em 1998.

FUNDO: papel-cartão marrom-expresso fosco (#3B2318) cobrindo a faixa inteira, com textura discreta de fibra de copo de papel e leve granulado. Uma luz quente lateral de balcão vem da esquerda e deixa o lado esquerdo um tom mais quente, com vinheta suave nas bordas.

NOME, o elemento dominante e o primeiro ponto do olhar: "Grão de Ouro" no centro exato, ocupando cerca de metade da largura e um terço da altura na parte superior central. Letra cursiva de pintor de letreiro desenhada à mão, peso alto e inclinada cerca de 12 graus. Contraste forte entre traços grossos de pincel e hastes finas, letras ligadas e espaçamento justo. O "G" e o "O" maiúsculos abrem volutas longas e elegantes. O "o" final solta um rabo que volta por baixo e sublinha a palavra inteira, e os terminais terminam em gota. As letras são preenchidas em folha de ouro batida (#C9A04A), com brilho metálico suave e irregular, pequenas fissuras e emendas da folha, e reflexos quentes da luz lateral. Atrás delas corre uma sombra projetada creme (#F1E6D0) deslocada para baixo e para a direita, e um filete fino vermelho-tijolo (#8E2F23) contorna a sombra.

SLOGAN: logo abaixo do nome, centrado e mais estreito (cerca de quatro décimos da largura), numa única linha: "Café de verdade, sem pressa". Romana serifada de letreiro em creme (#F1E6D0), caixa alta e baixa, com tracking levemente aberto.

FAIXA-FITA: sob o slogan, centrada e curta, uma fita vermelho-tijolo (#8E2F23) com pontas dobradas em rabo de andorinha e filete dourado nas bordas. Dentro dela, em versaletes creme pequenos e bem espaçados: "Desde 1998".

LATERAIS: dois painéis ornamentais verticais, estreitos e simétricos, um encostado na margem esquerda e outro na margem direita, ambos no terço médio da altura. São molduras de filetes finos em folha de ouro, com volutas de letreirista nas pontas, um pequeno grão de café dourado no centro e cantoneiras ornamentais. Esses painéis não levam texto.

CANTOS, em corpo pequeno e com muito ar em volta:
- canto superior direito: "Cuidado: bebida quente", em creme, sans condensada pequena com um filete dourado fino embaixo.
- canto inferior esquerdo, alinhado pela borda esquerda do painel lateral: "Belo Horizonte · MG", em versaletes creme com o ponto central dourado.
- canto inferior direito, espelhando a cidade: apenas uma pequena voluta dourada horizontal, sem nenhum texto.

Composição simétrica e centrada, com margens generosas, o centro respirando e um ritmo calmo. O resultado é acolhedor e artesanal, com orgulho de casa antiga. Apenas estes cinco textos aparecem, escritos exatamente assim: "Grão de Ouro", "Café de verdade, sem pressa", "Desde 1998", "Belo Horizonte · MG", "Cuidado: bebida quente". Nenhum outro texto, letra, logo ou @ aparece na arte.

image_instructions.prompt:
Wide, low 3:1 wrap-around band for a paper takeaway coffee cup sleeve, flat artwork, designed to read at a glance and as the cup turns. Background: deep coffee brown, a warm dark brown with fine paper grain, subtle foxing specks, faint dust and a soft amber glow from the upper left. The edges are worn, with a very thin antique-gold border rule inset from the edges. Leave generous empty margins at the far left and far right ends where the sleeve seam overlaps.

LAYOUT, with the centre as the hero. The headline "GRÃO DE OURO" sits top centre, spanning roughly the middle two-fifths of the width, on a single line, and dominates the eye. Beneath it, in the centre, is a circular gold seal about as tall as the lower half of the band. A small line "DESDE 1998" sits centred just under the seal, in a narrow block about a fifth of the width. To the right of the seal, in the right third, sits the slogan "Café de verdade, sem pressa" in two left-aligned lines ("Café de verdade," / "sem pressa"), set in cream. At the left, mirroring the slogan at the same height, is "CAFETERIA · BELO HORIZONTE" in two small centred lines ("CAFETERIA ·" / "BELO HORIZONTE"), in old gold, with a small coffee branch above it.

LETTERING: "GRÃO DE OURO" is in bold, upright, condensed serif capitals with sturdy slab-like bracketed serifs, like a vintage rubber stamp. The ink is matte, granular old gold (#C8963E). Ink density is heavier at the centres of the strokes and fades to dry-brush light edges where it ran thin. There are small partial ink voids and uneven impression depth, as if hand-pressed. The tilde on the Ã is crisp and legible. "DESDE 1998" is in the same stamped condensed serif capitals, gold, with wide tracking. The slogan is in a warm serif in cream (#F3E6CC), mixed case, medium weight, with a soft stamped ink texture and slight wear, easily legible. "CAFETERIA · BELO HORIZONTE" is in small stamped capitals in old gold with the middle dot kept.

SEAL: a circular badge in matte, aged gold leaf with a double ring border, a finely beaded inner ring and a slightly worn, softly embossed edge. The interior is dark coffee brown and holds a central coffee bean in gold with a sharp centre crease, flanked by two coffee-plant branches in roasted earth (#7A3E1D) and gold with glossy leaves and small red-brown cherries, curving around the bean. The seal carries no extra text. Warm amber light grazes the gold ridges, giving a soft metallic sheen without harsh glare.

DECOR: coffee-plant branches in roasted terracotta (#7A3E1D) with tonal leaves and cherries repeat along both sides, framing the seal and curling toward the ends, quiet and low contrast so that the text stays dominant. A vintage, warm, calm, heritage-café feeling, with patina, grain and gentle wear everywhere, never neon or glossy.

Flat wrap-around art for a takeaway coffee cup sleeve, very wide horizontal strip, to be read at a glance from two metres away. Background: deep roasted-coffee brown (#2A1810), nearly black at the edges with a barely visible leather-like grain, no ambient fill, everything luminous belongs to the gold.

HEADLINE, dominant, centred on the middle axis and spanning a little more than half of the strip width, in the upper-middle: "Grão de Ouro" in two words on one line. Custom bold Clarendon-style slab-serif lettering with mixed case: very heavy thick verticals, medium horizontals, large rounded bracketed serifs, small ink-trap notches at the stroke junctions, tight but even spacing, clear tilde on the ã. The letters are solid cast 24-karat liquid gold (#D9A441 warm gold), with real embossed thickness and bevelled edges like a stamped confectionery shop sign. Microscopic foil-crinkle texture on every face, deep amber and caramel pooling in the recesses, razor-bright champagne-white specular highlights on the upper-left edges of the serifs and stems. A single hard spotlight from the upper left at 45 degrees throws crisp caramel-brown (#8A4B2A) shadows to the lower right. A few tiny diamond-dust sparkles near the letter crowns, subtle.

ABOVE IT, small and delicate, centred over the name, spanning about a third of the width: "CAFETERIA" in widely letter-spaced slab-serif capitals, in cream (#F3E3C3) with a soft gold edge glint.

TOP EDGE: a very thin horizontal rule of caramel and gold metal near the top, running almost the full width with equal margins, with a fine highlight along it.

BELOW THE NAME, centred, about half the width of the strip and clearly smaller than the name: "Café de verdade, sem pressa" in cream (#F3E3C3), refined slab-serif lowercase with a light weight, generous spacing, legible and quiet, with a lot of air between it and the name.

LEFT: a small ornament in gold and caramel metal, vertically centred, at the left margin, such as a stylised coffee bean flanked by two fine curved flourishes, with the same foil texture and the same upper-left light.

RIGHT: a round seal in gold and caramel metal, vertically centred in the right margin, with a thin double ring border, containing the text "Desde 1998" in cream slab-serif on two lines, with cream and gold relief on the rim.

Lots of calm empty brown space around the blocks. Premium, warm, artisanal, unhurried mood. No other text, no address, no social handles, no logo, no steam, no cup, just the flat strip artwork.

Wide 3:1 panoramic band for a take-away coffee cup sleeve, viewed flat, as a finished luxury packaging design. Background: deep roasted-coffee brown (#2A1810), nearly black at the edges, with a soft warm caramel (#7A4A2A) glow pooling behind the bean and fading out; no other ambient fill, so all luminosity belongs to the gold.

SUBJECT: one single giant coffee bean stands upright in the centre, tall and dominant, taking most of the height of the upper two-thirds, in matte-polished gold (#D4A23A). Its surface is molten 24-karat gold with a microscopic foil-crinkle texture, deep amber pooling in the centre crease and recesses, and razor-bright champagne-white specular peaks along the upper-left curve. It is an embossed, cast relief with real thickness, like a precious-metal jewel. A single hard spotlight from the upper left at about 45° throws a crisp shadow to the lower right in caramel brown. A few fine diamond-dust glints and tiny gold-leaf flecks drift near the bean, sparse and never covering the lettering.

HEADLINE: "GRÃO DE OURO" sits directly below the bean, centred, spanning roughly three-quarters of the band's width, set on one line, readable at a glance. Letterforms: heavy, wide, high-contrast serif capitals with sharp bracketed serifs and generous tracking, with the tilde on the Ã crisp. They are cast solid gold with substantial physical depth, with three visible surfaces. Front face: a bright specular highlight at the centre, a warm gold mid-tone and deep amber at the edges. Top and side faces: different, darker gold tones as the letters turn away from the light, with a slight satin finish. Shadows fall to the lower right, matching the bean.

SUBHEAD: "Café de verdade, sem pressa" sits centred beneath the headline, much smaller, about half the headline's width, in cream (#F3E3B8), in a refined light serif with open spacing, flat and clean.

SIDE DETAILS, small and delicate, in cream (#F3E3B8) flat letters, set at the height of the lower half of the bean, flanking it with wide empty brown space between them and the bean: on the far left, "DESDE 1998" in small spaced capitals, left-aligned to the left margin; on the far right, "Belo Horizonte · MG" in small spaced type, right-aligned to the right margin. Both are equal in size and weight.

Composition: symmetrical and calm, with generous margins, the bean as the emotional focus, the headline as the anchor, and the small texts clearly secondary. Mood: warm, artisanal, unhurried, affordable luxury, where the cup becomes a small jewel. No other text, no logos, no borders, no cup mockup.

image_instructions.prompt:
Crie uma arte final de embalagem horizontal para uma faixa de copo de café para viagem, proporção 3:2, com autoridade de uma torrefação antiga de Belo Horizonte. Fundo profundo em café torrado #201611, como papel kraft escuro de fibra visível, suavemente gasto, com leve vinheta de luz âmbar e pontinhos de poeira dourada. No centro, um grande selo de torrefação em ouro velho #C79238: aro oval-circular ornamentado, filetes finos, pequenas marcas de impressão, medalhão e uma gravura original de estilo xilogravura de grãos de café, ramos e um antigo tambor de torra; tudo integrado como emblema, sem texto adicional.

Respeitar composição horizontal precisa: o slogan ocupa uma faixa estreita centralizada acima do selo, com bastante respiro lateral; o título é o foco absoluto no centro, largo porém contido no miolo, ocupando aproximadamente metade da largura; a assinatura repousa abaixo em uma faixa estreita centralizada. Dois blocos verticais de gravuras ladeiam o emblema, um à esquerda e outro à direita, ambos estreitos: grãos de café, folhas e detalhes de torrefação em traço de cobre envelhecido. Não transformar os textos auxiliares em arcos.

Texto superior, exatamente: “CAFÉ DE VERDADE, SEM PRESSA”. Compor em versaletes serifadas clássicas, creme de papel #F1DFC0, levemente prensadas e com desgaste sutil, alinhamento central e tracking arejado.

Título central, exatamente: “GRÃO DE OURO”. Criar letras maiúsculas serifadas, robustas e condensadas, desenhadas como um carimbo vintage oficial. Pigmento de ouro velho fosco com granulação de almofada de carimbo: tinta mais densa no centro dos traços, bordas de pincel seco, pequenas lacunas de contato e profundidade irregular de pressão. O dourado deve parecer um selo aplicado à mão sobre papel, não metal cromado. Sombra de impressão mínima em terracota #9B3D25, para firmeza e relevo.

Texto inferior, exatamente: “DESDE 1998 · BELO HORIZONTE”. Em pequenas capitulares de creme envelhecido, precisão de selo notarial, centralizado sob o título e separado por delicados pontos e filetes dourados. Acabamento de rótulo de café artesanal premium, legado e autenticidade; textura física, elegante e sóbria, sem objetos modernos, sem neon, sem textos extras.

No terço superior-central, começando bem afastado das bordas laterais e ocupando cerca de dois terços da largura, inserir exatamente “GRÃO DE OURO” em uma única linha, o elemento dominante. Letras serifadas altas, pesadas e levemente condensadas, inspiradas em um carimbo comercial antigo; pigmento ouro antigo fosco e granular, forte no miolo dos traços, bordas secas falhadas, pequenos vazios de tinta e impressão de pressão irregular no papel. O título atravessa o centro do selo e mantém legibilidade máxima.

Abaixo, alinhada à mesma borda esquerda do título e com a mesma largura contida, inserir exatamente “CAFÉ DE VERDADE, SEM PRESSA” em letras menores, maiúsculas, creme de algodão #F2E5CE, impressão tipográfica sutilmente desgastada, espaçamento generoso e leitura limpa. Mais abaixo, centralizado em uma faixa estreita sob o subtítulo, inserir exatamente “DESDE 1998” em ouro antigo envelhecido, pequeno porém nítido, entre dois pequenos grãos de café ou ramos lineares. Na base, uma faixa de ornamentos impressos — filete fino, rosetas discretas e grãos — percorre grande parte da largura, sem texto adicional. Visual de selo da casa confiável e acolhedor, tradição de cafeteria de Belo Horizonte, tinta tátil e acabamento artesanal envelhecido.

image_instructions.prompt:
Design gráfico plano para a capa impressa de um copo de café para viagem, proporção 3:2, sem mockup e sem texto adicional. Fundo principal em creme de algodão #F0E2C2, papel poroso de torrefação antiga, com grão fino, mínimas pintas de foxing e desgaste elegante. Um grande selo circular ornamental sem palavras ocupa discretamente a região central ampla: borda dupla em café torrado #3B2118 e ouro antigo #A66B24, pequenos ramos de cafeeiro, folhas e dois grãos de café desenhados como gravura, todos atrás da tipografia. O selo deve parecer estampado em papel, histórico, premium e sóbrio, nunca luxuoso demais.

Na faixa superior-central, começando bem afastado da margem esquerda e com largura média, coloque o headline dominante exatamente: “GRÃO DE OURO”. Letras slab serif geométricas autorais, muito robustas e largas, caixa alta, hastes e serifas retangulares sem brackets de espessura quase uniforme, curvas circulares firmes, espaçamento ligeiramente aberto. Tinta café torrado #3B2118, impressão letterpress profundamente pressionada no papel, bordas sutilmente quebradas e desgaste natural. Esta é a maior leitura da peça e o centro visual.

Abaixo, em uma faixa horizontal mais larga e alinhada visualmente ao centro, componha exatamente: “CAFÉ DE VERDADE, SEM PRESSA”. Slab serif em caixa alta menor, tinta terracota escura #6B2D22, alta legibilidade, letras retas e densas, sem curvatura.

Mais abaixo, em um bloco estreito central, coloque exatamente: “DESDE 1998”. Ainda menor, em café torrado, com dois pequenos pontos ornamentais e filetes curtos em ouro antigo nas laterais, sem acrescentar palavras.

Na faixa inferior seguinte, mais larga que a anterior e centralizada, coloque exatamente: “BELO HORIZONTE • MG”. Slab serif pequena em café torrado, bem espaçada, com o ponto médio preservado.

Na base, uma longa faixa decorativa quase de margem a margem: regra dupla fina em ouro antigo, interrompida ao centro por um pequeno losango terracota. Luz visual quente de âmbar, paleta limitada a creme, café, ouro antigo e terracota; acabamento de rótulo de torrefação estabelecida desde longa data, reconhecível tanto na mão quanto em movimento.

Use creme de papel #F4E7CA para as letras e ouro envelhecido #C9973D e castanho quente #7C4930 apenas nos detalhes impressos e sombras sutis. O elemento dominante é o título exato “GRÃO DE OURO”, centralizado na região superior central, ocupando uma faixa de largura média e cerca de um terço da altura visual. Desenhe letras slab serif geométricas, largas e robustas, com peso quase uniforme, serifas retangulares sem junção curva, formas circulares e sem contraste de traço; impressão creme de aparência firme e mecânica, com leve impressão em relevo, bordas de tinta discretamente gastas e acabamento tátil artesanal. Preserve acentos, espaçamento e grafia exatos.

Logo abaixo, centralize “Café de verdade, sem pressa” numa linha bem menor, ainda legível, em serifas sólidas coordenadas, creme envelhecido e espaçamento confortável. Reserve bastante ar entre os blocos. No rodapé, alinhe “BELO HORIZONTE · MG” à esquerda, em letras pequenas e claras, e “Desde 1998” à direita, também pequeno, equilibrando os dois cantos sem unir as linhas numa faixa. Mantenha a hierarquia e as posições laterais: não alargue os detalhes inferiores nem desloque o título ou o slogan.

À esquerda do título, um pequeno bloco gráfico estreito com ilustração gravada de grão de café em ouro envelhecido; à direita, outro bloco estreito com um ramo discreto de cafeeiro e um detalhe de grão, em traço de gravura antiga. Os ornamentos ficam nas laterais, sem competir com o nome e sem conter letras. Aparência de embalagem de cafeteria tradicional de Belo Horizonte, acolhedora e confiável, com acabamento de impressão patrimonial e desgaste sutil. Renderize somente as quatro frases fornecidas, exatamente como escritas; não acrescente palavras, símbolos tipográficos ou texto incidental.

Aparência de tinta sólida, ligeiramente quebrada nas bordas pelo desgaste, sem gradientes nem contraste dramático. Renderize exatamente: “Grão de Ouro”.

Os ramos voltam-se para o selo, sem tocar nem atravessar as letras. Acrescente poucos filetes ornamentais de impressão antiga ao redor do selo, sem competir com o nome. image_instructions.prompt:
Crie a arte final plana de uma cinta aberta para copo de café para viagem da cafeteria Grão de Ouro, em formato horizontal. Mostrar somente a superfície gráfica retangular, vista de frente, preenchendo integralmente a imagem: não mostrar copo, montagem fotográfica, perspectiva, mãos, ambiente externo, marcas de corte ou medidas.

Fundo inteiro verde profundo uniforme, na tonalidade de uma folha escura de cafeeiro, com acabamento de tinta fosca. Composição deliberadamente mínima, sem desenhos, ícones, selos, molduras ou ornamentos. A identidade vem das letras, do contraste de materiais e do espaço livre.

Renderizar exclusivamente estes três textos, com acentos e pontuação exatos: "Grão de Ouro", "Café de verdade, sem pressa", "Desde 1998".

O protagonista é "Grão de Ouro", em uma única linha centralizada, numa faixa muito larga próxima ao centro vertical, ligeiramente acima dele. O bloco ocupa quase toda a largura útil, preservando margens laterais iguais e generosas; sua altura é aproximadamente um quarto da composição. Desenhar letras Didone de luxo editorial: iniciais maiúsculas e demais letras minúsculas, hastes verticais dominantes, contraste extremo com horizontais quase capilares, eixo rigorosamente vertical, serifas horizontais delicadas e sem concordância, encontros abruptos entre traços grossos e finos, terminais em gota no a e no r. Contraf formas abertas e espaçamento opticamente equilibrado para reconhecimento rápido na superfície curva do copo. Preservar nitidamente o til de Grão.

As letras são impressão metálica plana em ouro acetinado, de tom ocre dourado, com granulação finíssima e reflexos largos. Sem relevo, bisel ou extrusão. Uma única luz dura oblíqua cria reflexos que chegam ao branco nas hastes grossas, enquanto os fios entram em sombra; manter seus contornos identificáveis. Esse contraste luminoso pertence somente ao metal: o verde permanece uniforme, sem manchas de iluminação.

Acima do nome, com uma faixa generosa de espaço entre ambos, colocar "Desde 1998" em creme opaco, pequeno e centralizado, dentro de um bloco estreito com aproximadamente a largura de um quarto da arte. Letras leves, nítidas e moderadamente espaçadas.

Abaixo do nome, separado por uma pausa visual ampla, colocar "Café de verdade, sem pressa" em uma única linha centralizada, em creme opaco. Seu bloco é mais estreito que o nome, abrangendo cerca de dois terços da largura. Usar letras discretas, bem abertas e legíveis, sem competir com a marca. Deixar uma extensa área verde livre abaixo do slogan. Nenhum texto adicional.

image_instructions.prompt:
Crie a arte gráfica plana e finalizada de uma faixa para copo de café para viagem da cafeteria Grão de Ouro, em composição horizontal. Mostrar somente a arte retangular de impressão, vista frontal, preenchendo o enquadramento: não apresentar copo, fotografia, mockup, perspectiva, cenário ou objetos. Fundo inteiramente mostarda #C79224, uniforme, com textura extremamente fina de papel não revestido. Tintas opacas, cores chapadas, bordas nítidas, sem metal, reflexos, degradês, relevo ou sombras projetadas.

Renderizar exclusivamente estes quatro textos, preservando rigorosamente acentos, caixa e pontuação, nesta hierarquia: "GRÃO DE OURO"; "Café de verdade, sem pressa"; "Desde 1998"; "BELO HORIZONTE".

A marca domina a região superior e central. Manter uma margem lateral generosa e igual dos dois lados e uma faixa de respiro livre acima. O bloco da marca ocupa quase toda a largura útil e pouco menos da metade da altura total. Compor o texto da marca em duas linhas compactas: primeira linha GRÃO DE, segunda linha OURO. Ambas alinhadas à esquerda no mesmo eixo, com entrelinha curta. Desenhar letras creme #FFF2D5 em sans-serif geométrica ultrapesada, proporções largas, traços quase uniformes, terminais planos com cortes retos e ângulos rigorosos. Espaçamento justo, massa densa e mecânica, curvas circulares firmes, contraformas abertas o suficiente para leitura rápida no copo. Preservar o til de GRÃO com desenho robusto e separação clara. A identidade industrial vem da geometria e do peso, nunca de efeitos metálicos. Colocar um pequeno desenho marrom-café #352116 de um grão dentro da contraforma do primeiro O de OURO: silhueta oval com uma fenda curva creme, inteiramente contida na letra, sem prejudicar sua leitura.

Após um intervalo de fundo livre, posicionar "Café de verdade, sem pressa" em uma única linha horizontal independente, alinhada à mesma margem esquerda da marca. Esse bloco atravessa a largura útil, com tamanho bem menor que a marca, mas claramente legível, em marrom-café #352116, peso médio e desenho geométrico limpo.

Perto da base, após outro intervalo generoso, criar dois blocos pequenos na mesma linha: "Desde 1998" à esquerda, alinhado ao início da marca, ocupando apenas a região esquerda; "BELO HORIZONTE" na metade direita, terminando na margem direita da composição. Usar marrom-café, peso médio e espaçamento cuidadosamente ajustado. Manter uma margem inferior livre. Nenhuma moldura, legenda adicional ou ilustração fora das letras.

É a própria arte gráfica da embalagem, não uma fotografia de produto: sem copo, perspectiva, dobras, cenário externo, gabarito, marcas de corte ou margens brancas.

Conceito: Ouro sem Ostentação. Fundo inteiramente verde profundo #173C32, uniforme, liso e fosco. Nome em ouro fosco #C6A45C; slogan e data em creme #F4EAD6. Acabamento de impressão refinado, com cores sólidas e bordas extremamente nítidas, sem granulação, textura, brilho metálico, relevo, degradês ou sombras. Iluminação difusa e uniforme, sem pontos luminosos. A elegância vem das proporções das letras e do espaço vazio.

Renderizar exclusivamente estes três textos, com acentos e grafia exatos, nesta hierarquia:
“Grão de Ouro”
“Café de verdade, sem pressa”
“Desde 1998”

O nome é o elemento dominante, em uma única linha, alinhado à esquerda com margem lateral generosa. Começa abaixo de uma ampla área superior vazia e ocupa a região superior intermediária, estendendo-se por quase toda a largura útil, deixando respiro à direita. Desenhar letras serifadas largas, de tradição clássica inglesa e proporções romanas: capitais imponentes, minúsculas abertas, serifas com transições curvas delicadas, hastes firmes e filetes finos mas claramente imprimíveis. Contraformas espaçosas, ritmo calmo e espaçamento óptico arejado sem desfazer a unidade das palavras. O til e os demais sinais devem ser claros. O ouro é pigmento fosco opaco: hastes largas com cor estável e filetes delicados, sem cintilação ou aspecto cromado.

Abaixo de um intervalo vazio generoso, posicionar “Café de verdade, sem pressa” em uma única linha, compartilhando exatamente a margem esquerda do nome. Este bloco ocupa pouco menos de dois terços da largura total. Usar letras sem serifa de desenho limpo, peso regular, tamanho nitidamente menor e espaçamento levemente aberto, em creme.

Posicionar “Desde 1998” pequeno na região inferior direita, dentro de um bloco estreito, alinhado à direita e afastado das bordas. Usar a mesma família limpa do slogan, em creme, com leitura fácil.

Preservar o topo, os intervalos e a base como áreas de silêncio visual. Não centralizar os blocos, não acrescentar ícones de café, grãos, selos, molduras, linhas decorativas, ilustrações ou qualquer texto adicional.

image_instructions.prompt:
A luxury nightclub wordmark photographed at night as exterior facade signage: the single word "VOID" in four capital letters, nothing else written anywhere. Solar-eclipse logic: the letters themselves are the absence, and the light around them is the signal.

LETTERFORMS: custom geometric sans capitals, medium-bold, slightly extended, with zero stroke contrast and perfectly flat, square-cut terminals. The V is two thick straight strokes meeting in a crisp sharp point. The O is a perfect true circle with an even ring stroke. The I is a plain vertical bar. The D is a straight stem joined to an exact half-circle bowl, with crisp right-angle corners where bowl meets stem. Tracking is wide and even, with roughly a third of a letter's height of open space between each glyph. There are no serifs, no inline, no bevel, no ornament. The strokes are thick and confident so each letter casts a clean silhouette.

MATERIAL AND LIGHT: each letter is a solid fabricated channel letter in matte velvet-black metal, standing a few centimetres off a polished-honed black stone wall. The letter faces are completely dark and non-reflective, almost invisible, with only the faintest graphite edge on the side returns. Warm brass-gold light pours from behind every letter onto the stone, forming a tight, even corona that hugs each outline. It is brightest right at the letter edge, a hot champagne-white rim, and melts through brass-gold into darkness within a hand's width. The inside of the O's counter and the D's bowl glow too, so every shape reads instantly. The letter edges are razor-sharp black silhouettes cut against the glow. No neon tubes and no visible light sources: only the reflected halo on the stone. The stone shows a subtle fine grain and soft graphite texture where the glow touches it.

COMPOSITION: the word sits dead centre, spanning the middle of the canvas width, with equal empty margins left and right. The halo forms a wide luminous band around the word that extends only slightly past the outer letters. Directly below, the same width as the word and aligned to its left and right edges, is a strip of wet black pavement. It holds a faint, soft, mirrored warm reflection of the haloed letters, broken by gentle ripples and darker than the sign itself. Everything else, the large majority of the frame above, beside and below, is unlit velvet-black wall and night, with a soft falloff into total darkness at the edges.

PALETTE: velvet black for the facade and letter faces, graphite stone for the wall texture and letter returns, brass-gold corona, hot champagne at the brightest halo edge. No other colours.

MOOD: quiet, expensive, exclusive, monumental restraint. Simple enough to read as a crisp black-on-gold silhouette from across a dark street. No people, no logos, no tagline, no extra text.

image_instructions.prompt:
A premium nightclub wordmark: the single word "VOID" as a backlit halo sign on a black wall, shot straight-on and perfectly centred in a square frame. The only text in the image is "VOID" — no other letters, words, logos or marks anywhere.

COMPOSITION: "VOID" sits on one horizontal line in the exact optical centre of the canvas. The word spans a little under half the frame's width and is short in height, so it sits as a calm, contained band. The halo glow forms a soft rectangle of light only slightly larger than the word itself. Around it, the vast majority of the square is unbroken, featureless black wall with equal, generous margins on all four sides: no frame, no border, no props, no second element. The emptiness is the design.

LETTERFORMS: ultra-heavy geometric grotesque capitals of maximum black weight with absolutely zero stroke contrast. Proportions are near-square and neutral, neither condensed nor extended, and each letter is a self-contained geometric block. All terminals are flat-cut at exact right angles, with no taper, flare or rounding.
- The V is two massive diagonal slabs meeting at a flat-cut apex.
- The O is a monumental ring with a perfectly circular counter, symmetric on its centreline.
- The I is a single pure vertical slab.
- The D is a straight stem joined to a clean geometric bowl.
Letter spacing is wide, even and architecturally calibrated. The word feels like prestige cinema title type at building scale: quiet, colossal, certain.

MATERIAL: the letters are solid matte black channel letters, near-black #050506 on their faces. The faces are completely unlit and light-absorbing, almost indistinguishable from the wall in tone. Each letter is mounted a few centimetres off the wall on hidden standoffs. The shallow side returns are graphite #1A1B1E with a faint satin sheen catching a thin edge of the glow, just enough to hint at depth.

LIGHT: a crisp, cold white halo #DDE6F2 spills from behind every letter onto the matte black wall, including inside the counters of the O and the D. It is brightest right at the letter edge and falls off quickly to steel blue-grey #7F8FA6 within a short hand's width, then dissolves into total black. Each glyph becomes a razor-sharp black silhouette ringed in cold light, like an eclipse that spells the name, and the word reads instantly from far away even though the letters themselves are dark.

WALL: matte black #050506 with a very subtle, fine painted-plaster texture visible only where the halo grazes it.

WHAT TO AVOID: no colour beyond black, graphite and cold white-blue. No haze, fog or smoke. No light rays or lens flare. No floor and no reflections other than the halo on the wall. No glow on the letter faces.

The overall feel is expensive, door-policy restraint: deep black everywhere, one controlled cold light, sharp edges.

A minimal luxury nightclub wordmark, 16:9 landscape. The only text is the word "VOID" in capitals, exactly these four letters, nothing else anywhere in the image.

LETTERFORMS: "VOID" is drawn as hollow outline capitals. Each letter is described only by its outer contour: one continuous, unbroken, very fine hairline path tracing the perimeter of the glyph. The interior of every letter is completely open and black, with no fill.
- The stroke is perfectly uniform in weight, with no thick-thin variation, like a single bent filament.
- Every corner turns through a smooth rounded bend with a natural minimum radius, never a sharp angle. The point of the V and the corners of the D are softly radiused.
- The skeleton is a wide geometric sans-serif: flat terminals, no serifs, clean vertical and horizontal stems.
- The O is a near-perfect circle drawn as a double contour ring, and the D has a generous round bowl. Counters are open and clearly readable.
- The I is a slim upright rectangle outlined by the same line.
- Letterspacing is very wide, roughly one full letter-width of empty black between each character, so the word reads as four calm, evenly spaced shapes.

MATERIAL AND LIGHT: The line itself is light. Its core is pure white-hot white, the brightest thing in the frame, crisp and sharp-edged. Around it sits a tight, cool ice-blue bloom, only a few stroke-widths wide, fading quickly to nothing. There is no wide glow, no flare, no colour other than white and pale ice blue on the line. Up close it is almost nothing, a thread of light; at distance it cuts through the darkness.

COMPOSITION: The wordmark sits on the vertical centre axis, slightly above the middle of the frame. It spans only a modest central band of the width, with vast black margins left and right. Directly below it, sharing the same centred column and the same width, is a dark polished floor. On that floor lies a faint, soft, vertically flipped mirror reflection of the hollow letters, much dimmer than the original. The reflection is slightly blurred and fades downward into the wet slate-grey sheen, separated from the word by a thin strip of darkness. The word dominates and the eye lands on it first; the reflection is a quiet echo. Everything else, the overwhelming majority of the canvas, is unbroken darkness.

WORLD: Deep matte blue-black night fills the entire background, flat and textureless, with no haze, smoke, particles, stars, city, walls or vignette gradients. The only light source is the line of the letters. The floor is barely perceptible, a dark slate tone visible only where it catches the reflection, its horizon dissolving invisibly into the black.

MOOD: Precise, cold, silent and expensive. An exclusive minimal mark whose power comes purely from a bright clean edge against total darkness.

AVOID: No tagline, no extra letters, no frame or border, no filled letters, no thick neon tubes, no mounting hardware, no colour beyond white, pale ice blue and blue-black.

image_instructions.prompt:
A finished nightclub logo on a 16:9 canvas: the single word "VOID" in four wide-set capital letters, drawn as one hairline of cold white light on a dark street facade. Nothing else is written anywhere in the image.

Roughly two thirds of the frame is empty darkness on both sides, with generous space above and below. The word is the only subject. It feels discovered in the dark, not placed. The eye lands on it at once because nothing competes.

LETTERFORM: custom geometric capitals V, O, I, D. They are tall and light, with a perfectly uniform ultra-thin monoline stroke, open apertures, sharp clean joins on V and D, a perfect circular O, and a plain vertical I with no serifs. Letterspacing is very wide, about the width of a letter between each, so the word reads clearly at distance. Each letter is a single continuous hairline path of light, like a thin neon tube, not a filled shape. The counters of O and D stay dark and empty.

The halo spreads wider on the outer edge of each stroke than on the inner edge, like real gas-tube light. The brightness drifts very slightly along the stroke for an organic tube feel. The glow is tight and restrained, not a heavy bloom, so the edges stay crisp and the line stays thin but luminous enough to carry 50 metres. A faint cool scatter of blue light touches the surrounding darkness very close to the letters and fades out quickly.

ACCENT: one extremely fine horizontal hairline rule in the same cold white light sits centred beneath the word, about the width of the letters I and D together, set a modest distance below the baseline. It is dimmer than the letters.

BACKGROUND AND FLOOR: the backdrop is a vast dark street facade in Street Black (#050506) with a barely visible matte plaster texture and a very subtle vertical gradient, slightly lifted by the pale blue scatter so it is not flat dead black. The lowest portion of the frame is a wet asphalt surface (#15171C) with a faint glossy sheen. It shows a soft, short, blurred reflection of the word and rule as vertical streaks of pale blue-white fading quickly into darkness. No other objects, no people, no signage, no decoration, no extra text. Quiet, cold, expensive, almost invisible yet unmistakable.

image_instructions.prompt:
夏祭りの屋台の軒先に掲げる、縦長の「かき氷」の看板。昭和の氷屋の軒先に下がっていた白い木綿の氷旗そのものを、一枚の絵として描く。

【舞台と光】
背景は夏の夜の深い闇（#1B1A2E）。画面の上端に、節のある細い竹竿が横に一本渡してある。そこから生成り色（#F4EEDF）の粗い平織り木綿の旗が、画面のほぼ全面を覆うように垂れ下がる。旗の左右の縁にはわずかに闇がのぞく。布目の凹凸、上辺の竿袋の縫い目、端のほつれた糸まで見える。
旗の真後ろに吊るした紙提灯の橙色（#F2A541）の灯りが、布を内側からふんわり透かす。織り目の隙間が粒のように温かく光り、中央ほど明るく、周縁は穏やかに沈む。旗の輪郭には柔らかな光のにじみ。
画面の左上隅、旗の端の外側に、和紙の丸い提灯がひとつ半分ほど顔をのぞかせる。竹ひごの骨が透け、橙の灯りがこぼれている。
旗の下端は風を受けてかすかに波打ち、縁の糸がゆれる。

【主役の文字「かき氷」】
中央やや左寄りに、縦書きで「かき氷」の三文字を大きく染め抜く。旗の上部から下部の波の帯の手前まで、旗の高さの大半を貫く一本の柱にする。文字の幅は旗の幅の四割ほど。これが数メートル先からまず目に入る主役になる。
色は朱赤（#D8352A）。極太の筆文字で、ずんぐりした骨格にする。「か」「き」は丸みのある懐の広い形、「氷」の最後の払いは右下へ勢いよく長く伸ばす。筆の入りは太く重く、終筆には毛先のかすれを残す。字間は詰め気味にし、三文字がひと続きの柱のようにつながる。
朱の染料は布目に深く沈み、輪郭は繊維に沿ってわずかににじむ。後ろからの灯りで、染料の濃い部分は落ち着いた深紅に沈み、かすれた筆跡の隙間からだけ橙の光が細く漏れる。

【添え文字】
旗の右上の端に、小さな縦書きで「夏祭り」。藍色（#24477A）の細めの筆文字で、主役の天よりやや高い位置から控えめに下りる。
主役の左側、旗の中ほどより下に、縦書きで「よく冷えてます」。藍色の小ぶりな筆文字で、主役とは十分な間をあけ、ささやくように添える。
どちらも主役の三分の一以下の大きさにとどめ、同じく布に染めた質感とにじみを持たせる。

【下端の帯と千鳥】
旗の下端から約二割の高さは、旗の幅いっぱいに藍の波模様の帯にする。昔の氷旗らしい、くるりと巻く青海波と白い波頭を型染め風に描く。帯の上の生成りの空間には、藍の千鳥を三、四羽、軽やかに飛ばす。藍も布に染みたにじみと透け感を持つ。

【全体の印象】
文字は「かき氷」「夏祭り」「よく冷えてます」の三つだけを、一字一句このとおりに描く。それ以外の文字や値段、ロゴは一切入れない。
左上の提灯のほかは闇と布と灯りだけの、静かで懐かしい一枚。昭和レトロな駄菓子屋の温かさ。布の手触りと、灯りに透ける朱と藍がそのまま伝わる、写実的で落ち着いた質感にする。

image_instructions.prompt:
A finished horizontal 16:9 Showa-era dagashi-shop signboard, photographed straight on as the front of a summer-festival stall eave. The whole canvas is one old sheet of corrugated tin painted faded teal-green (#2E5E6B), with soft vertical corrugation ridges, rust blooms creeping from the edges and bolt holes, flaking paint, drips and scratches, enclosed by a thick dark-brown (#3A2418) weathered wooden frame with visible grain along all four edges. A bare incandescent bulb hangs on a twisted black cord from the top centre edge, glowing orange (#F2A33A); it throws a warm pool of amber light over the tin, strongest around the upper middle, with orange sheen on the ridges and rust, falling off into deep brown shadow in the corners. Faint dust motes drift in the light cone.

Layout: the headline "かき氷" is massive and dominant, centred, spanning about three quarters of the width and sitting in the middle band of the sign. Letterforms: hand-painted extra-heavy rounded gothic, fat round fleshy hiragana, stroke ends slightly swollen, subtle sign-painter wobble, tight letter spacing, the kanji 氷 stroke-strong and bold. Fill is cream (#F4E7C8) with a thick vermilion-red (#C8281E) outline, and a dark-brown shadow offset one step down-right for a solid dimensional feel. Paint shows dry-brush scratches, tiny cracks, chipped edges and rust showing through, with warm bulb highlights on the cream.

Above the headline, centred at the top just below the bulb, a small separate "氷" in the same hand-painted style, cream with red outline, about one fifth of the width, framed by the bulb glow.

Below the headline, a line "いちご・レモン・メロン・ブルーハワイ" spans roughly three quarters of the width, left-aligned with the headline's left edge area, painted in medium-weight rounded hand-lettered gothic in cream with a thin red edge and small brown shadow, set on a faded vermilion painted band with worn edges.

In the lower right, a smaller block "一杯 {{price}}円" sits right-aligned under the flavour line, about a quarter of the width, cream lettering with red outline and brown shadow, on a worn red painted plate; the price token is left exactly as written.

Overall: warm nostalgic, muted aged colours, never neon, light amber glow, readable from far away, an authentic hand-painted festival stall sign.

image_instructions.prompt:
昭和レトロな夏祭りの屋台、かき氷屋の軒先に掛けられた横長の琺瑯ブリキ看板。夕暮れから夜、遠目で読まれる前提で、文字は大きく太く、コントラスト高め。

【世界】看板は古い木の軒(#7A4A2A)と板壁に釘留めされ、背景は夜の藍(#2B3A55)の深い影。画面の左右上方に吊られた紙の提灯が、橙(#F2A33A)の温かい光を斜めから看板に落とす。提灯は画面の端に半分見切れ、和紙の骨のシルエットと柔らかな光のにじみ。軒先には小さな氷の旗、ガラスの器に盛られた氷とシロップの色の小さな絵(赤・黄・緑・青)、駄菓子の瓶のシルエットなどを控えめに添えて賑やかさを出す。看板の四隅に丸いリベット、縁は生成り(#F4E7C8)の細い二重の縁取り罫、角は丸み。地は褪せた朱赤(#C8321E)の琺瑯塗装で、縁や角の塗装剥がれから黒い鉄地と茶色い錆が覗き、細かなひび割れ、雨だれの跡、微かな凹み、ほこりっぽい粒子感。提灯の光が当たる部分は艶のあるハイライト、遠い部分は藍の影に沈む。

【文字(一字一句そのまま)】全て太く均一な線幅、角ばったスラブ状の端部を持つ幅広で頑丈な書体。盛り上がった琺瑯塗装のように縁が少しにじみ、わずかな圧のある印刷の質感、擦れと小さな剥げ。
1. 主見出し「かき氷」:看板上部の中央やや広い領域(横幅の約七割)を占める最大の文字。生成りクリームの文字に、褪せた朱赤の濃い縁と下方向の厚い影、その外側に生成りの細い縁。三文字が堂々と並び、提灯の橙の光が文字の上端と左肩にハイライトを落とす。視線が最初に着地する場所。
2. 副題「氷 つめたい 夏の味」:見出しの下、中央寄せ、横幅の約六割。生成りクリームの文字、単色で見出しより大幅に小さい。
3. 「いちご・レモン・メロン・ブルーハワイ」:その下、見出しとほぼ同じ左右幅で一行、生成りクリームの小さめの文字。中黒を保ち、間に小さな味の色の丸を置かずに文字だけで読ませる。
4. 「{{price}}」:さらに下、中央の幅の狭い区画に、生成りの縁取りの小さな札(朱赤地)の中に入れる。
5. 「ごあんない 当店自慢のみぞれ」:最下段の右寄りに小さく、右側の約三分の一の幅、生成り文字。左側は余白として、軒先の小物が見える。

【配色】褪せた朱赤、生成り、提灯の橙、夜の藍、古い木の五色のみ。ネオンのような明るさは避け、全体にあせた温かい色調。余分な文字は一切入れない。

image_instructions.prompt:
夏祭りの屋台に掲げる横長の看板幟。生成りの木綿の布(#F6EFE0)一面に、赤い染料(#C8202A)で文字を染め抜いた「氷旗」の世界。布目と糸の凹凸がはっきり見え、風で軽くたわんで柔らかい影を落とす。夕方の橙色(#E8A33D)の光が斜めから布を照らし、提灯のような温かさ。昭和レトロな駄菓子屋の素朴な空気。遠目で読めるよう、最もシンプルで強い構成にする。

文字は次の5つのみ、一字一句そのまま:「かき氷」「氷」「いちご・レモン・メロン・ブルーハワイ」「{{price}}」「夏まつり」。

配置:
・最上端に横幅いっぱいの藍(#2F5D8A)の帯。青海波と波千鳥の模様で、上端に竹竿を通した袋縫いと細い竹竿が見える。
・中央上部の最大要素は「かき氷」。極太の筆文字で横幅の約8割を占め、中央に据える。字面は大きく詰め気味。横画は力強く止め、縦画は太く、はね・はらいは短く抑える。墨ではなく赤い染料を布に塗り込んだ質感で、輪郭は少しかすれ、布の目に染み込んで縁が滲む。最初に目に入る主役。
・左端に、見出しより小さい縦長の枠で「氷」を一字、同じ太筆の赤で縦に大きく染める。氷旗の「氷」を思わせる。「かき氷」の左に寄り添い、上端は見出しとほぼ揃う。
・見出しの下に余白を取り、「いちご・レモン・メロン・ブルーハワイ」を一行で、幅広の中サイズ。同じ赤の太めの筆文字風で、見出しより明らかに小さく、中央揃え。
・その下の中央に、やや狭い幅で「{{price}}」を赤で大きめに染める。周りに十分な余白を残す。
・「夏まつり」は小さな赤い文字で、最下部の藍の波帯の中に白抜きで入れる。波帯の邪魔をしない大きさ。
・最下端に横幅いっぱいの藍の帯。青海波と波千鳥の模様で、白く抜いた波が連なる。

質感と光:赤は少し褪せて布に染み込み、擦れた箇所にわずかな滲みと白い抜けが出る。藍の帯も染めの濃淡があり、布目が透けて見える。橙の斜光が布のたわみに沿って明暗を作り、柔らかい影が落ちる。背景は布そのもので、余計な小物は置かない。赤・生成り・藍・橙の4色で統一する。

5. 最下段中央（横幅の約50%を占める引き締め領域）：「ひんやり冷たい・名物」の文字列が、ラムネ紺（#1B4B7A）の端正な手描き角丸文字で中央揃えに配置されている。

1. 上段（幅約60%）：朱赤のペンキで控えめに、素朴な楷書風の手書き文字で「天然水仕込み」と横書き。
2. 中段（幅約70%・主役）：画面の最大の見どころとして、極太でふっくらと丸みを帯びた昭和屋台丸文字で堂々と横書きされた「かき氷」。練乳を思わせる温かみのある生成り白の油性ペンキ（#FFF6E5）が肉厚に盛り上がり、筆の払い端にリアルなペンキ溜まりと微細なひび割れが見える。朱赤（#FF4D2E）の細い縁取りが手描き特有の僅かなブレを伴って施されている。
3. 下段（幅約50%）：上段よりやや小さめの朱赤ペンキ文字で、親しみやすい丸みのある手書き筆文字の「ひんやり冷えてます」。

ライティングと空気感：画面右上と左上の枠外近くに吊るされた赤提灯から、温かいアンバーオレンジの光（#FFB84D）が斜めに差し込み、木板の凸凹やペンキ文字の立体的なエッジに柔らかなハイライトを落としている。背景の奥は縁日の賑わいを感じさせる藍色の宵闇と祭りの提灯のぼやけたボケ光が漂う。職人の手仕事の温もりと、どこか懐かしいノスタルジーに満ちた仕上がり。

directions.pitch: 藍染めの暖簾を思わせる縦書き看板。大きな白い文字と提灯の灯りだけで、夕暮れの屋台らしい温もりを落ち着いて伝えます。

image_instructions.prompt:
昭和の駄菓子屋の店先に掛かる、横長のかき氷屋台看板。画面いっぱいに看板の正面をほぼ平行に見せ、読みやすさを最優先にする。地は生成り色 #F2DFC0 の古い琺瑯板。縁のごく内側を細い藍墨の線で囲み、角や縁に控えめな欠け、擦れ、淡い錆の点を見せる。画面の外周に暗い木の店先をわずかにのぞかせる。

主文字は「かき氷」。看板中央の幅いっぱいに近い領域へ、横一列で大きく配置する。太く幅広い手描きの刷毛文字で、画の太さはほぼ均一、角はわずかに丸く、ひらがなは親しみのある丸い形。「氷」の画を詰めすぎず明瞭にする。朱赤 #B8322A の塗料で描き、払いの先には短い刷毛筋を残す。各文字の輪郭に沿って藍墨 #263F4A の細い影を添える。塗料には控えめな経年の擦れを入れつつ、文字の形と判読性は保つ。

その下に十分な間を取り、短い添え文「夏のひんやり」を、主文字よりずっと小さく、看板中央の狭めの幅に横一列で配置する。藍墨色の素朴な手描き文字。上下にも余白を保つ。

左上の余白に小さな無地の紙提灯を一つ吊るし、主文字とは重ねない。提灯の灯り #E7A950 が生成りの琺瑯と赤い塗料を柔らかく温め、表面の刷毛跡と古びた質感を浮かび上がらせる。穏やかな影、褪せた色調、ごく微かな埃。看板に記す文字は指定の二行だけとし、提灯や周囲にも別の文字、数字、記号を入れない。
